title: Seat record (SEAT_PROTOCOL §1)
description: Normative schema for <coordination-root>/<project_id>/sessions/<letter>.json. Stage-0 r4 [4] blocked the prose version: a record that cannot be validated cannot deliver the write-and-read validation §1 requires. Lease and watcher are SHAPE ONLY here — their semantics belong to o's protocol delta (17:49Z split) and this schema deliberately does not encode acquisition, fencing, or renewal rules. VALIDATOR REQUIREMENT (r5 [9]): `format` is ANNOTATION-ONLY in Draft 2020-12 unless format-assertion is enabled. Implementations MUST validate with format assertions on, or timestamps are unchecked strings — a rule that silently does not run is the fail-open class this record is built against.

schema_version.description: Integer, not semver: readers branch on exact equality and refuse unknown versions rather than guessing compatibility.

project_id.description: Immutable adoption identifier, using the same grammar as the project state store.

letter.description: Canonical lowercase ASCII seat letter. Shape does not confer role membership or authority.

model.description: From the generated matrix. NULL means unprobed, never 'no model' — absent would be indistinguishable from unknown, which is the fail-open shape this record exists to avoid. Null is legal ONLY in state=booted; every tier-resolved state forbids it (see allOf).

effort.description: From the generated matrix. NULL means unprobed. Null is legal ONLY in state=booted; every tier-resolved state forbids it (see allOf).

session_handle.description: Claude conversation UUID or Codex thread id. Null only while booted-but-unregistered.

state.description: §2 canonical set. `stalled` and `dead` are DERIVED VERDICTS and are never self-written — a record carrying them is itself a finding.

heartbeat.description: Written ONLY by the seat's own turn-end hook (§2). No external process writes these fields; a watchdog-authored heartbeat certifies false liveness.

cadence_seconds.description: Bare integer. Prose here is REJECTED, not coerced: an i.txt reading 'none (wake loop STOPPED deliberately)' once killed the whole stall-watchdog sweep under set -u.

conclusion.description: §4a requires reason AND brief for a dormant claim to take; the watchdog refuses dormancy without both.

brief.description: Resolvable path to the durable brief a successor boots from.

superseded_by.description: §2 parked-revival: set to the superseding fencing token. A quarantined handle that un-parks observes this, performs NO side effects, and self-concludes.

last_probe.description: Externally maintained launch/probe outcome, kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the canonical STALLED predicate (which stays heartbeat-only per §2). It selects the recovery branch and never triggers a stall by itself. `unresponsive_unknown` is named once in SEAT_PROTOCOL (§3:128) and given no recovery branch — spec delta 3.

capabilities.description: PROBED, never declared. Absent is not false; an unprobed capability is ABSENT, so a reader cannot mistake 'never checked' for 'not supported'. Origin: a seat's RC channel was found silently dead inside a live process and only a recycle re-registered it — a declared capability is a claim about the past. Value types are key-specific: SEAT_PROTOCOL §1 defines watcher_locations as an ARRAY and external_invoke as an enum, which a blanket boolean|string cannot express (r5 [6]). An EMPTY watcher_locations forbids standby/doorbell mode — so the empty array is meaningful data, not an absent value.

lease.description: SHAPE ONLY — reserved. Semantics (flock-CAS, ULID token equality, stall-episode binding, causally-fenced release) belong to o's SEAT_PROTOCOL delta. This schema does not encode them and an implementation must not infer them from the shape. NOT nullable: a required-but-null value carries no more information than an absent one (cross-review blocker, 2026-07-28).

holder.description: Fencing token (ULID). null is the NORMAL state — healthy seats run unleased.

epoch.description: Human-readable revival counter with NO fencing role; fencing is token equality.

watcher.description: SHAPE ONLY — reserved, same split as lease. Note §1's own caveat: an in-session watcher is conforming only while an externally-readable renewal is current, because a record of existence proves nothing — a dead watcher leaves the same record. NOT nullable: a required-but-null value carries no more information than an absent one (cross-review blocker, 2026-07-28).

allOf.description: A dormant seat MUST carry a complete conclusion (§4a) — dormancy without a ceremony is indistinguishable from a stall.
An active or standby seat MUST carry a heartbeat — those states are defined by heartbeat recency (§2 predicate table).
A null session_handle is legal ONLY in `booted` (pre-first-turn). Any other state with a null handle is an unregistered seat claiming to be live — r5 [5].

Tier verification is mandatory (§3): in every state past pre-first-turn the resolved model and effort MUST be present. A live seat with an unresolved tier is the fail-open shape this record exists to prevent, and null there is indistinguishable from unprobed.
